headline: Walmart (WMT) Fuels Growth With InHome Delivery Expansion
summary:
Walmart Inc. WMT has been focused on enriching customers’ experiences through better e-commerce options, especially enhanced delivery services. The omnichannel retailer has unveiled plans to expand its InHome delivery service to 30 million U.S. households from six million households. The expansion is expected by the end of this year.

In connection with this, the supermarket giant intends to appoint more than 3,000 associate delivery drivers this year to support the planned delivery expansion.
